title: Zesty Crunchy Brazilian Turmeric Gratin
description: A delicious Brazilian dish that combines the flavors of turmeric and crunchy breadcrumbs with a hint of herbal notes to alleviate hangover symptoms.

ingredients.name: Yucca root
ingredients.notes: peeled and sliced into 1/2-inch thick rounds

instructions: Heat coconut oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the garlic, onion, and chopped fresh cilantro and sauté until the onion is translucent.
Add the sliced yucca root and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Sprinkle the turmeric powder, salt, and black pepper over the yucca root and stir to combine.
Transfer the yucca root mixture to a baking dish and set aside.
In a separate pan, heat the ghee over medium heat.
Add the breadcrumbs and cook, stirring frequently, until they are golden brown and crispy.
Sprinkle the toasted breadcrumbs over the top of the yucca root mixture.
Transfer the baking dish to the oven and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 20-25 minutes, or until the breadcrumbs are golden brown.
Remove the gratin from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
